svg.title: H09 / PERSEVERANCE LAKE ARCHIVE engineering mission profile
svg.desc: H09, PERSEVERANCE LAKE ARCHIVE. Original project: Trends in Mineralogy and Grain Size Distribution Across Paleolake Basins on Mars. Session H: Planetary Science. Scientific question: Are spatial mineral and effective-grain-size trends better explained by sediment transport and sorting, in-place alteration, or later dust and surface modification? Testable hypothesis: Models conditioned on mapped stratigraphic and geomorphic units will predict independent spectral and thermal observations better than a basin-wide composition model, while some grain-size estimates remain intrinsically nonunique..
